key_insight: Injecting ε-level perturbations into unobserved matrix directions yields matrix-sensing surrogates with valid restricted isometry property (RIP) constants and solutions O(ε)-close to the ground truth.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a theoretical route to improving low-rank recovery by combining controlled noise with over-parameterization.
method: Perturb the nullspace of the observation mask at ε scale.
Construct noisy matrix-sensing surrogates satisfying RIP.
Use RIP to enable theoretically guaranteed tensor frameworks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical recovery guarantees under independent entry sampling, without explicit sampling-rate or incoherence requirements; no empirical evaluation is described.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish the practical cost or numerical stability of constructing RIP-valid surrogates.
paper_title: Improving the Optimization Landscape of Matrix Completion with $ε$-close Surrogates
